metadata.description: Community marketplace of reusable Azure SRE Agent plugins (skills) plus their companion 'extras' (subagents, scheduled tasks, knowledge base) that the marketplace itself does not carry.

plugins.name: azure-network-health
plugins.description: Reference-led comprehensive Azure network configuration assessment adapting Usman Mahmood and Network Desk procedures, with contextual specialist reviews, source-backed executive/engineering reports and guarded private publication. Read-only; no logging changes or invented effective health.

plugins.name: azure-tag-governance
plugins.description: Builds a provenance-aware Azure tag and basic naming governance profile from read-only evidence, evaluates resources deterministically, and publishes immutable assessment bundles.

plugins.name: sla-reporting
plugins.description: Estimates Azure availability/SLA per region, service, and month from real-world Resource Health, renders an SLA service-credit heatmap, and lists Service Health incidents for context. Native adaptation of Guil Lima's Get-AzureSLAReport.ps1 (no Automation Account, no Excel).

plugins.name: vm-migration-preassessment
plugins.description: Orchestrates a governed AzVMTools Deep preflight through a private GitHub Actions runner and converts GO/NO-GO results into a scoped Azure VM migration change plan. Performs no migration actions.

plugins.name: wara-assessment
plugins.description: Runs Microsoft's Well-Architected Reliability Assessment (collector + analyzer) one scope at a time, including in restricted-egress SRE Agent sandboxes, and produces a provenance-tracked, prioritized findings report with month-over-month deltas. Read-only.
